name: Bay State Bam
description: American Mahjong instruction and hosted events across Massachusetts, run by OMM-certified instructor Brittany Ela; home of the Troop Mahjong Boston/Worcester chapter (leagues, socials, open plays).
schedule: Monthly Troop Mahjong league, social and open play events; also hosted private parties.

name: JCC Greater Boston Drop-in Mah Jongg
state: Weekly ongoing American Mah Jongg drop-in at the Leventhal-Sidman JCC. Open to all skill levels who know the basics; NMJL rules and current NMJL card required.
schedule: Tuesdays 12:30–2:30 PM and Thursdays 10:00 AM–12:00 PM, Wexler Family Lounge. No pre-registration; free for members and $5 for non-members.
